notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: Oklahoma City is still without Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace, Aday Mara, Jaylin Williams and Nikola Topic, so the offense runs almost entirely through him. He played 38 and 37 minutes in his last two games, and Milwaukee is on the second night of a back-to-back after losing at Detroit on Friday.
notes.Joel Embiid: Embiid played 28 minutes on Friday because Philadelphia never trailed in a 24-point win at Indiana, and tonight is the second night of a back-to-back. The 76ers have not filed today's injury report yet, so his status is not posted.
notes.Franz Wagner: Paolo Banchero and Kevin Porter Jr. are both out again, and Wagner has been Orlando's lead option, playing 32 and 38 minutes in his last two games. Anthony Black is questionable with back soreness, which could put even more of the ball in his hands.
notes.Alperen Sengun: Sengun played 31 and 32 minutes in his last two games as Houston's hub, and the Rockets are rested while Philadelphia plays the second night of a back-to-back. Steven Adams is questionable, which could add to Sengun's center minutes, but a 12.5-point spread brings some blowout risk.
notes.Tyrese Maxey: Jaylen Brown has missed games with left hamstring tightness, which leaves more of the scoring with Maxey, and he played only 29 minutes on Friday because the Indiana game was a blowout. Philadelphia has not filed today's injury report yet, so the statuses of Brown, Embiid and LeBron James on this back-to-back are not posted.
notes.Bennett Stirtz: Stirtz started Wednesday and played 24 minutes because Oklahoma City is missing Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace, Nikola Topic, Aday Mara and Jaylin Williams. All six are out again tonight, so the cheap rotation minutes are still there.
notes.Noah Clowney: Clowney has been Brooklyn's backup center behind Day'Ron Sharpe and played 26, 27 and 21 minutes in his last three games. Brooklyn is on the second night of a back-to-back after Friday's loss at Toronto, and the Nets have not filed today's injury report yet, so their statuses are not posted.
notes.Isaac Okoro: Okoro has started each of Chicago's last three games and played 31 minutes on Wednesday, with Norman Powell (right hamstring strain) and Caleb Wilson out again tonight. His value comes from defense, steals and rebounds more than scoring.
notes.Anfernee Simons: Simons played 25 minutes off the bench on Friday with Jaylen Brown out, up from 15 and 18 in his previous two games, and the blowout helped. Philadelphia has not filed today's injury report yet, so whether Brown, Embiid or LeBron James sit on this back-to-back is not posted, and that decides Simons's role.
notes.Egor Demin: Demin has come off the bench since Nov. 20 and played only 17 minutes in Friday's lopsided loss at Toronto. With Nolan Traore out with a hamstring strain he is Brooklyn's backup point guard, but the Nets have not filed today's report on this back-to-back, so their statuses are not posted.
notes.Dean Wade: Wade did not play Friday at Indiana after playing 28 and 26 minutes off the bench in his previous two games. Philadelphia has not filed today's injury report yet, so his status for tonight is not posted.
notes.Christian Anderson: Anderson played 25 and 28 minutes off the bench in Charlotte's last two games because Dennis Schroder and Grayson Allen were out. Schroder and Kon Knueppel are out again tonight, but Allen is questionable in the concussion protocol, and his return would cut into Anderson's minutes.
notes.Bilal Coulibaly: Coulibaly has come off the bench in the low to mid 20s in minutes, with 25 and 22 in Washington's last two games. Washington is without Jamir Watkins, Tristan Vukcevic and Justin Champagnie tonight, which keeps his wing minutes steady.
notes.Kevin Durant: Durant played 33 minutes in each of Houston's last two games, and the Rockets face a Philadelphia team on the second night of a back-to-back. A 12.5-point spread brings some blowout risk.
notes.Josh Giddey: Giddey played 34 minutes on Wednesday with Norman Powell and Caleb Wilson out, and both are out again tonight. His minutes have swung from 22 to 41 this week because Chicago pulls him late in some close games.
notes.Coby White: White has played 25 to 28 minutes in each of his last three starts as he works back toward a full workload. Norman Powell is out again tonight, which keeps the shot volume in Chicago's backcourt with White and Giddey.
notes.Pascal Siakam: Siakam played only 25 minutes on Friday because Indiana lost by 24 to Philadelphia, and tonight is the second night of a back-to-back. Tyrese Haliburton is practicing but has missed 15 straight games, and Indiana has not filed today's injury report yet, so its statuses are not posted.
notes.Brandon Miller: Miller has played 32 to 35 minutes as Charlotte's lead scorer with Kon Knueppel out, and Knueppel and Dennis Schroder are out again tonight. Grayson Allen is questionable in the concussion protocol.
notes.Tre Jones: Jones has played 12 to 27 minutes off the bench this week, mostly the minutes Josh Giddey does not, and he closed Wednesday's win at Charlotte. Norman Powell and Caleb Wilson are out again tonight.
notes.Anthony Black: Black is questionable with back soreness. He has started with Paolo Banchero out and played 35 and 28 minutes in his last two games, so if he sits, Tristan da Silva and Jalen Suggs pick up more of the work.
notes.Dom Barlow: Barlow started Friday with Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade out but played only 18 minutes because the game was a blowout. Philadelphia has not filed today's injury report yet, so whether he starts again on this back-to-back is not posted.
